children: Barclays economists expect China's retail sales growth to slow sharply from 3.7% in 2025 to around 1% in 2026. The slowdown would mark the weakest pace in history, excluding the pandemic years, they say in a report. The weakness in retail sales reflects a combination of structural headwinds, including more aggressive household deleveraging, sizable negative wealth effects from the prolonged property sector downturn, a shrinking population, and a deteriorating labor market. Policymakers' reluctance to deploy a more forceful consumption-focused stimulus is likely to prolong the adjustment process, they say. (monica.gupta@wsj.com)
